decided_by: PI, 2026-09-28: define the Generalist once, before the next 2v2 baseline; reuse it unchanged at 4v4 and 6v6.
fills: CROSS_SCALE_BASELINE_SUITE_V1_SPEC.json#FOUR_ARMS_locked.A_generalist (pi_G(a|o), no strategy code) -- that record fixes the policy form only, not how pi_G is produced or scored.
supersedes_for_the_suite: the legacy r1_pi_G_generalist_seed7000001 (PPO, 2M steps, legacy pipeline) remains provenance only (PI_G_EVAL_SPEC.json); it is not a suite Generalist at any scale.

PRODUCTION_locked.architecture: the scale's specialist architecture exactly (read from the KL teacher pi_A checkpoint), one network, latent_k=0, no z embedding, no strategy encoder, no router
PRODUCTION_locked.initialisation: fresh random draw under one registered training seed; a bit-identical specialist weight matrix is refused as a silent warm start
PRODUCTION_locked.objective: 0.5*KL(pi_A||pi_G) + 0.5*KL(pi_B||pi_G) on every stored decision-eligible state (the Fully Shared+z objective with z removed: both KL terms act on the same output)
PRODUCTION_locked.dataset: the SAME frozen suite dataset every sharing arm at that scale consumes
PRODUCTION_locked.recipe: identical to the sharing arms: 20 epochs, batch 256, Adam lr 3e-4, grad-norm clip 1.0, no weight decay, actor-only (critic frozen), no early stopping, terminal weights only
PRODUCTION_locked.split_and_sampling: identical to the sharing arms (holdout = episode % 10 == 9 per pole; batches stratified half Pole A / half Pole B)
PRODUCTION_locked.why: the only difference from Fully Shared+z is the strategy code, so the Generalist row isolates what telling the network which strategy to play buys

SCORING_locked.why_not_crossover_delta: a single policy has Delta_A = Delta_B = 0 by construction
SCORING_locked.ours: the scale's main Separated system (frozen pi_A ATTACK + pi_D DEFEND, CLOSEST_DEFENDS), evaluated on the SAME seeds as pi_G so Delta_G is paired; that run is a matched reference and never replaces the scale's main Separated value
SCORING_locked.bootstrap: experiments/eval_hog_psp_v3.py::_mean_ci (paired percentile over seeds, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7)
SCORING_locked.headline: mean effects; 95% intervals for figures (PI reporting rule 2026-09-27)

ALLOWED_TO_DIFFER_ACROSS_SCALES: tensor dimensions that follow mechanically from N
NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_RECORD: any training or seed spend (each scale's sharing spec authorizes its own)
